name: Red air: Gerbera decoy / light OWA (G2)
description: Cheap foam decoy flown inside Shahed streams to saturate defenses. Same corridors and altitudes as the OWA it mimics.

spanM.source: Ukraine Defence Intelligence (HUR) War & Sanctions portal

maxSpeedMps.source: Ukraine Defence Intelligence (HUR) War & Sanctions portal

maxTurnRateDegS.note: Planning factor: coordinated-turn rate g tan(bank) / V. The 45° roll limit is the ArduPlane default (ROLL_LIMIT_DEG 45; PX4 FW_R_LIM 50°), the autopilot class these small fixed-wing UAS fly with. At the record's cruise speed 33 m/s: 17°/s. No turn rate, bank limit or g limit is published for this airframe.

climbRateMps.note: Planning factor: No Gerbera source publishes no climb rate. The ArduPlane TECS_CLMB_MAX default and the PX4 FW_T_CLMB_MAX default are both 5.0 m/s for a small fixed-wing UAS.

maxAccelMps2.note: Planning factor: No Gerbera source publishes no acceleration. About 18 kg on a DLE60-class 7 hp engine (Jerusalem Post; Wikipedia). A propeller airframe with thrust-to-weight near 0.3 and cruise drag near 0.1 of weight accelerates at about 0.2 g = 2 m/s² in level flight.

radiatedPowerW.note: Planning factor: No Gerbera source publishes no link power. Gerbera carries a Xingkai XK-F358 mesh modem and, on some airframes, 3G/LTE modems (CSIS; Wikipedia). The only OEM-published link power in this threat set is Mugin's SprintLink family (2 W, 5 W, 10 W at 1.4 GHz for 30 to 150 km); the 2 W entry-level class is used for a small-UAS command and video link.

attributes.emissionsNote: Some carry emitters to mimic Shahed signatures
attributes.rangeNote: About 300 km with a combat payload; unarmed decoy flights reported to 600 km.

threatProfile.routeIntent: Interleaved in OWA stream as decoy

linkProtocol.source: Wikipedia, Gerbera (drone): XK-F358 mesh modem relays operator signals; CSIS, Shahed/Geran: mesh radio XK-F358 and ZTE 3G/LTE modems
linkProtocol.note: Mesh radio relay; cellular modems on some airframes.
